people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Yahweh said to Jacob, “Return to the land of your fathers, and to your relatives, and I will be with you.”
translations.bsb: Then the LORD said to Jacob, “Go back to the land of your fathers and to your kindred, and I will be with you.”
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred;
translations.asv: And Jehovah said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.
